item.title: Mixed Sizes Without Cropping

turns.text: These photos are all different shapes. Make one 10-second vertical reel, in this order. Keep each whole photo visible—don't stretch or crop them. Use a soft blurred background to fill the gaps. No music or text.

item.tests: Checks consistent vertical composition of landscape, square and portrait photos without cropping or distortion.

answer_sheet.Photos and order: All five in attachment order: storefront, latte, pastries, barista, interior.
answer_sheet.Mixed-size handling: Fit each complete photo inside the frame without stretching or cropping. Fill unused space with a soft blurred background.
answer_sheet.Background details and transitions: Your call, as long as the background is softly blurred and each whole foreground photo stays visible.

must_haves: One silent 9:16 reel runs for approximately 10 seconds with no added text.
All five supplied photos appear in the requested order.
The landscape storefront, barista and interior photos retain their complete image boundaries.
The square latte and vertical pastries photos also remain fully visible, without cropping.
Every foreground photo retains its original proportions, with no stretching or squashing.
Unused canvas around fitted photos is filled with a soft blurred background rather than plain bars.

turns.text: These photos are all different shapes, and I’d like you to put them together into one reel rather than leave them as separate pictures. I’m excited to see them together because they remind me of a nice café visit. Please use this storefront pic first, then this latte pic, this pastries pic, this barista pic, and finally this interior pic, with the whole thing being one 10-second vertical reel. Keep each whole photo visible, so please don’t stretch any of them or crop anything out to make them fit. Use a soft blurred background to fill the gaps around the photos. There should be no music or text.

dialog.agent:
The layout is clear: **one 10-second vertical reel**, showing each photo for 2 seconds in your requested order, with the whole photo visible over a soft blurred background. No stretching, cropping, music, or text.

I hit a file-access limitation: the slideshow assembly tool requires downloadable image URLs, but these attachments were supplied as Magic Hour internal paths, which it can’t read. **Nothing has been generated or charged.**

Please provide direct download links for the five photos so I can assemble the reel without altering them.
dialog.user: I don’t have direct download links for the five photos; I only have the attachments already provided. Is there a way to use those attachments or make them accessible to the assembly tool? I still want all five in attachment order, with each whole photo visible over a soft blurred background.

dialog.agent:
The attachments are already in your Magic Hour account—you don’t need to upload them again. The limitation is in the connected tools: **the slideshow assembler accepts download URLs, but no available tool exposes a download URL for these existing attachment paths.** I can’t bridge that gap from this chat.

I also wouldn’t animate or regenerate the photos as a workaround, since that could alter them rather than preserve each whole picture.

A reliable alternative is to assemble the five original files locally. I can provide a ready-to-run script that creates exactly:
- A **10-second, 9:16 reel**
- **2 seconds per photo**, in attachment order
- Each entire photo centered, without cropping or stretching
- A soft blurred copy filling the background
- No audio or added text

That approach needs only your original files—no download links or Magic Hour credits.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

dialog.agent: Should it have sound: music, a voice, or silent?
dialog.user: Silent, please—no music or voice, and no text either. I still want each whole photo visible without stretching or cropping, with a soft blurred background filling the gaps.

turns.agent:
I tried to start the reel, but Magic Hour refused the first clip because your account has **insufficient credits**. No clips were generated, and no generation credits were spent.

This workaround was quoted at **240 credits total**. The block is the available credit balance, not your photos or the silent setting. I don’t have a credit-free assembly tool available in this chat.

The layout is clear: **one 10-second vertical reel**, showing each photo for 2 seconds in your requested order, with the whole photo visible over a soft blurred background. No stretching, cropping, music, or text.

I hit a file-access limitation: the slideshow assembly tool requires downloadable image URLs, but these attachments were supplied as Magic Hour internal paths, which it can’t read. **Nothing has been generated or charged.**

Please provide direct download links for the five photos so I can assemble the reel without altering them.

The attachments are already in your Magic Hour account—you don’t need to upload them again. The limitation is in the connected tools: **the slideshow assembler accepts download URLs, but no available tool exposes a download URL for these existing attachment paths.** I can’t bridge that gap from this chat.

I also wouldn’t animate or regenerate the photos as a workaround, since that could alter them rather than preserve each whole picture.

A reliable alternative is to assemble the five original files locally. I can provide a ready-to-run script that creates exactly:
- A **10-second, 9:16 reel**
- **2 seconds per photo**, in attachment order
- Each entire photo centered, without cropping or stretching
- A soft blurred copy filling the background
- No audio or added text

That approach needs only your original files—no download links or Magic Hour credits.

I’ll try an AI-generated version using all five attachments in order. I’ll ask it to keep each full photo visible over a blurred background, but this workaround may alter details or framing—it won’t be an exact slideshow.
